name: Evidence Interaction Hinge
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data/state, `(O)` = operation, `[!]` = missing interaction.

                         EVIDENCE INTERACTION HINGE

 [D] Representation element / `DiagramElementMapping`
      |
      | hover: Evidence label, summary, and source location
      v
 (O) Mapped element -> Evidence reveal
     `AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:385-425`
      |
      | activate -> `App.revealCodeEntity` (`App.tsx:1673-1693`)
      +---------------------------+
      |                           |
      |                           +---- rectangle drag ----> (O) Rectangle -> Evidence reference buffer
      |                                source-range-aware refs; tray copy / insert / dispatch / remove / clear
      |                                `DiagramView.tsx:223-241`; `refBuffer.ts:58-83`
      |
      v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [D] Evidence - user-interaction hinge                                               |
|      Representation grounding lands here before any Corpus reveal.                  |
|                                                                                      |
|  [D] `EvidenceEntity`                                                               |
|      stable `id`, handle, label, kind, summary, and `SourceRange[]`                  |
|          Evidence-to-CodeEntity compatibility boundary                              |
|          `EvidenceSchema.fromCodeEntity` (`domainProfiles.ts:10-31`)                 |
|  [D] persisted `CodeEntityRecord` (`domain.ts:99-129`)                               |
|                                                                                      |
|  (O) Inspect Evidence and choose source range                                        |
|      `CodeEntitiesPanel` shows metadata and `path:line` choices                      |
|      stable `sourceRangeId` preferred; range index remains legacy-compatible         |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
      |
      | active range -> `sourceSnippet`
      v
 (O) Evidence -> authoritative Corpus reveal
     `CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:150-189`; `application.ts:2279-2303`
      |
      v
 [D] Authoritative Corpus passage: source or Markdown, with immutable snapshot overlay
     Direct Corpus access bypasses the hinge only during explicit browsing.

                         ASSOCIATED EVIDENCE CONTEXT

 [D] File paths group Evidence by normalized SourceRange path
     `fileTree.ts:55-103`; select exact range in `FileExplorerPanel:203-217`
      |
      v
 [D] Selected Evidence / exact entity and range
     preserves source Diagram provenance in buffered references
      |
      +---- selected refs ----> (O) Focus selected Evidence in call graph
                                 verify both artifacts; return matches + ancestors

 [D] Representation revision + stable element identity
     + [D] Evidence identity/range + optional excerpt/tree lineage
      |
      v
 [D] Persistent Evidence-backed highlight
     `HighlightRecordV2` (`highlights.ts:20-56`); `application.ts:2320-2385`

                              CURRENT GAP

 [!] Missing Evidence -> all Representations navigation action

 [D] Selected Evidence - - - - - - X - - - - - -> [D] All Representations
     Resolver lookup exists: `RepresentationIndex.resolveEvidence/resolveElement`.
     No current `CodeEntitiesPanel` universal action; this interaction is FUTURE.
